# forumulate_site (Resource)

A site gathers public spaces under one address so they share a header, a footer and a theme. `space_ids` is its membership, `config_json` its shared chrome and look (header and footer links, theme, search, SEO, analytics, ...), and `page_mounts` publishes single pages of member spaces at a path of the site (`/pricing`) or at its root.

Destroying a site dissolves the grouping; every space in it survives with its own content and theme.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "forumulate_site" "main" {
  slug      = "main"
  name      = "Acme"
  space_ids = [forumulate_space.docs.id, forumulate_space.blog.id]

  config_json = jsonencode({
    copyright = "© Acme"
    headerLinks = [
      { label = "Docs", href = "/docs" },
      { label = "Blog", href = "/blog" },
    ]
    cta = { label = "Start free", href = "https://acme.example/signup" }
  })

  # One page of a member space answers at a path of the site.
  page_mounts = [
    { path = "/", space_id = forumulate_space.marketing.id, page = "home" },
    { path = "/pricing", space_id = forumulate_space.marketing.id, page = "pricing" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The site's name, 1 to 160 characters.
- `slug` (String) The site's slug (2 to 48 characters, lowercase letters, digits and hyphens). Changing it replaces the site.

### Optional

- `config_json` (String) The site's config, deep-merged into the stored one: nested objects merge, lists and scalars replace, and a key you remove from the configuration is cleared. Keys: header/footer chrome (`cta`, `header`, `headerLinks`, `footerLinks`, `footerColumns`, `navMenu`, `mobileNav`, ...), `theme`, `search`, `searchSettings`, `seo`, `analytics`, `comments`, `discovery`, `ai`, ... Page mounts are `page_mounts`. A JSON document: write it with `jsonencode()`. Drift is detected only for the keys you declare, so settings someone else manages are left alone.
- `external_ref` (String) Your own reference, fixed at creation.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Free-form tags. Replaced whole when changed. The API does not return them on a read, so drift is not detected.
- `page_mounts` (Attributes List) Single pages published at a path of the site (up to 50). The space must be a member, the page must exist, and a path may not shadow a member space's own segment. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--page_mounts))
- `space_ids` (Set of String) The member spaces (their ids, up to 100). When set, the site's membership is exactly this list. Leave it out to leave membership alone: later public spaces join the oldest site by themselves.
- `translations_json` (String) The site's name and description in other languages, per language code (`name`, `description`, `seoTitle`, `seoDescription`, `pages`). Replaced whole when changed. A JSON document: write it with `jsonencode()`. Drift is detected only for the keys you declare, so settings someone else manages are left alone.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the site was created.
- `id` (String) The site's id (a UUID).

<a id="nestedatt--page_mounts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `page_mounts`

Required:

- `page` (String) The page's slug in that space.
- `path` (String) Where the page answers: `/` for the root, or one segment such as `/pricing`.
- `space_id` (String) The member space the page belongs to (its id).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import forumulate_site.main main
```
